svg.title: Imports flow one way
svg.desc: PaperLens modules in import layers, from leaf modules like config and chunking up through backends, adapters, the search and pipeline flows and the ingest CLI, to server and eval, which compose rag and are never imported by it.

svg.text: A module imports only from layers below it — no cycles. rag never imports server or eval, and the two composers never import each other.
